summary: News Corporation filed a routine 8-K reporting daily ASX disclosures tied to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A and Class B common stock. The exhibits (99.1, 99.2) were provided to the Australian Securities Exchange on the dates noted therein; no new authorization, price, or share count was disclosed. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or tender mechanics are stated, as open-market buybacks continue under prior authorization. Watch ongoing repurchase pace against leverage and any signal of accelerated buybacks supporting NWSA/NWS relative value.
